sharedPrompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one individual species plate for a satirical Polish institute's field guide, displayed on warm ivory paper.
Input image: the supplied specimen.webp is a STYLE reference only. Match its vintage educational book illustration: precise black pen contours, fine restrained crosshatching, flat hand-tinted colours, natural human proportions, gentle deadpan humour, no exaggerated cartoon head. Draw an older Polish man with a moustache and thinning grey hair, related to the reference but with the wardrobe and pose described below. Keep ink #161513, ivory #f4f0e7, muted blue #3d6696, ochre #d49a2a and restrained stamp red #c4362c; skin warm pale peach; brown leather.
Composition: landscape canvas, aspect ratio 6:5, one vignette centered with a full visible character and only the defining props. Main figure and props fill 88% of the canvas height and 85% of its width, approximately the same scale as other plates. Clean genuinely transparent background, no rectangle, no paper texture behind the subject, no backdrop, no enclosing frame, no shadows cast onto a background. Restrained detail readable in a 180px wide thumbnail.
Constraints: ONE plate and ONE principal character; no lettering, labels, captions, logos, watermarks, signatures, legible UI or speech bubbles. Blank papers and screens when needed. Do not recreate the supplied original pose; use the species-specific pose.

edits.bieszczadzki: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the supplied Bieszczadzki species illustration. Add a visibly full, medium-length, scruffy GREY BEARD covering his chin and cheeks below the existing moustache, as a recognisable field mark of this species. Change only his facial hair. Keep his face, expression, hands, pose, clothes, backpack, blue rolled mat, map, grass, fine pen-and-ink crosshatching, muted colours and the entire composition unchanged. Preserve genuinely transparent background, no new props, no text, no labels, no white rectangle.

subjects.grill: Standing stout man wearing an ivory short-sleeve shirt, ochre shorts and a muted-blue apron, white socks and leather sandals. Solemnly grips metal barbecue tongs above a small round charcoal barbecue holding two sausages. Other hand on hip; just a thin curl of smoke. The tongs are the central recognisable attribute.
subjects.parking: Standing stern older man in ivory short-sleeve shirt, ochre shorts, socks and sandals, arms firmly folded, guarding a blue bucket placed on one simple parking line. A cropped corner of an old blue car at the side, but keep the man dominant. Territorial and watchful.
subjects.budowa: Standing older man in ivory work shirt and brown trousers, carpenter pencil tucked behind his ear, pointing critically at a tiny unfinished brick wall. Holds a yellow spirit level in the other hand; simple tool belt and a small drill at his feet.
subjects.moto: Standing older man with moustache and grey hair under a plain blue baseball cap, ivory shirt and brown trousers. One shoe prodding a car tyre, looking knowingly at it, keys hanging from his hand. A small cropped front fender of an old muted-blue sedan; no brand.
subjects.wakacje: Older man standing with arms akimbo in ivory short-sleeve shirt, ochre shorts, white socks, leather sandals, bucket hat and brown belt pouch. Beside him a low striped muted-blue and ivory folding beach windbreak and a rolled towel. No sea or full landscape.
subjects.facebook: Older moustached man with reading glasses low on his nose, seated on a simple chair in ivory shirt and ochre trousers, peering suspiciously at a small smartphone and jabbing at it with one finger. Faint blank screen with tiny abstract blue squares, no logo or text.
subjects.smart: Older moustached man with glasses on his forehead, ivory shirt and brown trousers, holding a smartphone in one hand while leaning over and deliberately pulling a black plug from a socket on a little table. On table is a muted-blue Wi-Fi router with two antennas and a blank ivory sticky note.
subjects.dzialka: Older man in straw hat, rolled-up ivory shirt sleeves, ochre shorts, white socks and leather sandals. Holds a blue watering can over a healthy single tomato plant tied to a stake with three red tomatoes, while looking over a short wire fence. Small old blue portable radio by his feet.
subjects.wedka: Older moustached man in bucket hat and ochre fishing vest with many pockets over ivory shirt, brown trousers. Sitting quietly on a folding blue stool, holding a fishing rod, a thermos and an EMPTY bucket by his feet. Small suggestion of water directly under float, no fish or landscape.
subjects.korpo: Older moustached man wearing muted-blue office suit, ivory shirt and restrained red tie. Stands holding a tall stack of printed blank emails, looking gravely at the paper. Small office printer next to him and a brown briefcase by his feet. No text.
subjects.zeglarz: Older moustached man in white captain's hat with dark-blue band, muted-blue striped shirt and brown trousers, inspecting an elaborate rope knot held in front of him. One foot beside a coil of rope and a very small wooden bollard. No boat or seascape.
subjects.grzybiarz: Older man in plain cap, blue jacket and brown trousers tucked into dark rubber boots, holding a wicker basket containing a few brown mushrooms. A small wooden-handled mushroom knife held safely down in his other hand. Looking secretively to the side.
subjects.przygraniczny: Older man in blue baseball cap, ivory shirt and ochre trousers, holding two long blank receipts up for comparison. Two brown fuel jerrycans by his feet and a small cropped car boot edge behind them. No flags, map, money symbols or text.
subjects.oszczednosciowy: Older man wearing reading glasses, ivory shirt and brown trousers, meticulously nesting reusable shopping bags inside one blue shopping bag. A small orderly stack of empty glass jars at his feet and a folded blank shop leaflet tucked under his elbow.
subjects.uzdrowiskowy: Older moustached man in a blue blazer and brown trousers, standing elegantly with a small white spa drinking cup with spout in one hand and blank folded treatment card in the other. A simple park bench fragment alongside him. Confident dancing posture, no landscape.
subjects.gorski: Older moustached man with a small brown backpack, ivory shirt, ochre shorts, tall white socks and leather sandals. Stands on a single grey rock with walking stick and a blue thermos in hand. Slight exertion, no mountain panorama.
subjects.festiwalowy: Older moustached man in ivory shirt and brown trousers seated in a blue armchair, singing gravely with one hand raised as if critiquing a singer, the other gripping a television remote. No television, music notes or writing.
subjects.golebiarz: Older moustached man in a blue cap, ivory shirt and ochre trousers, holding a grey racing pigeon gently in both hands, looking up to the side. A small wooden pigeon coop box beside him and a tiny old race clock on the box. Only one pigeon.
subjects.jurajski: Extremely elderly man with grey moustache, blue cardigan, ivory shirt and brown trousers, lecturing with raised index finger and holding a walking stick. Beside him an unassuming large grey ammonite fossil on a small rock; absurd time-depth conveyed without text or dinosaurs.
subjects.meteorologiczny: Older moustached man in ivory shirt and brown trousers, bent slightly forward with one hand rubbing his knee and the other lifting a round wooden barometer. Looks cautiously upward. Barometer has abstract tiny dial marks but no letters or numbers. No cloud background.
subjects.krupowkowy: Older moustached man wearing a traditional dark highlander hat with small feather, thick ivory wool sweater and brown trousers. Holds a decorative wooden shepherd's axe walking stick and a small piece of smoked mountain cheese. No mountains, buildings or lettering.
subjects.bieszczadzki: Older man with grey beard and moustache, weathered blue shirt, brown trousers and walking boots. Worn ochre backpack on his back, rolled sleeping mat strapped above it. Holds a folded blank map while staring pensively into the distance. A single grass tussock by his boots.
subjects.weselny: Older moustached man in an ivory dress shirt with sleeves rolled up and brown suit trousers, red necktie tied across his forehead with the loose tie falling to one side. Stands delivering an emphatic speech with one arm raised; jacket draped over adjacent small chair. No drinks or text.
subjects.wigilijny: Older moustached man in ivory collared shirt under a muted-blue sweater with small restrained ivory reindeer pattern, brown trousers. Dozing in a simple ochre armchair, hands on belly, slippers, with a small dinner plate and folded napkin on a side stool. No text or Christmas backdrop.
subjects.parapetowy: Older moustached man in ivory short-sleeve shirt, arms firmly folded on a blue cushion atop a simple window sill. His head and upper torso peers out between two pulled-aside ivory net curtains. The window fragment is an isolated vignette; sternly observing the street, no wall or street backdrop.
subjects.kolejkowy: Standing older moustached man with reading glasses and a brown belt pouch, ivory shirt and ochre trousers. Points firmly to the side while gripping blank postal notice and blank documents in a clear plastic sleeve. Keep one principal character, no full queue, no counter or text.
subjects.kibicowski: Older moustached man wearing an ivory shirt and red-and-ivory football scarf, brown trousers, seated leaning forward in a muted-blue armchair. Elbows near knees, one hand gripping television remote, other hand pointing decisively at an unseen match. One football by the armchair, no team crest or TV.
subjects.kempingowy: Older moustached man in straw hat, ivory short-sleeve shirt, ochre shorts, socks and sandals, sitting with arms folded in a muted-blue folding camping chair. Spirit level protruding from pocket, small cropped ivory caravan wheel and door corner next to him. No full camping site or backdrop.
